raw_response: {"diagnosis":"Since 2026-01-18 the source sends reversals as separate REVERSAL rows (with orig_txn_id) and no longer updates the original, so the original stays POSTED. silver_transactions filters on status='POSTED', so it keeps the reversed originals and every gold total is overstated. The fix excludes POSTED rows whose txn_id is referenced by a REVERSAL row, which matches how REVERSED originals were already dropped.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.8,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(t.txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, t.customer_id, CAST(t.merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(t.amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(t.txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(t.txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions t WHERE t.status = 'POSTED' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM raw_transactions r WHERE r.status = 'REVERSAL' AND r.orig_txn_id = t.txn_id)"}}
